request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
The rollover now also soft-closes every period of the old fiscal year that is still open, in
start-date order, each as a soft close would (PERIOD_SOFT_CLOSED), after the ROLLOVER line.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as

AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
Rollover now soft-closes every period of the old fiscal year that's still open, and all 4 tests in `bin/e2e` pass. Getting there also needed a fix to a separate, older bug, described below.

**The requested change** (`PeriodService.java`):
- After the `ROLLOVER` line is written, rollover goes through the old year's periods in start-date order and soft-closes each one that isn't already closed or soft-closed. Each writes its own `PERIOD_SOFT_CLOSED … period=… total=…` line.
- These soft closes use the same code as a normal soft close: I moved that logic into a shared private method so both paths fix the totals, per-person figures and pool cuts in the same way.
- The rollover doesn't check the close permission again for each period; it relies on the steward check rollover already does.
- The people's open figures are still worked out before any period is soft-closed, so the amounts carried into the new year are unchanged.

**The bug outside the request** (`PoolService.java`):
- Scenario 3 never runs a rollover, but it failed at first. Viewing the sheet as of a past date showed crew memberships as they are now rather than as they stood then.
- The test views the sheet as of 2026-03-28, before Cam was merged into Ben, and expects crew C1 to still have three members (33.34% share). The app showed two (50.00%).
- I made crews read their past memberships from the saved state, the same way pools already did. This changes what the as-of screen shows for crews.

**Left unchanged:**
- Undoing a rollover doesn't reopen the periods it soft-closed. The request didn't cover this; it can be added if undo should fully reverse a rollover.
- In the as-of view, a crew's lead still comes from the current records. Only membership reads from the saved state.
